beginnerNotes: This profile is the 50W module on Gweike G6 Split. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other power options via the chips before buying.
proTips: Batch similar jobs to reduce setup. Use rotary only when quotes include cylinder work — it slows flat-stock days.
